notes: Proxy Checker Dead Proxy Classification:: Broadened `isProxyDeadError` pattern matching to comprehensively catch all SOCKS proxy handshake failures (`socks5 initial handshake`, `no accepted authentication type`, `invalid socks version`, `proxy rejected connection`), connection aborts (`operation was aborted`), premature socket closures (`socket closed`), timeouts (`etimedout`, `econnaborted`), and proxy HTTP tunnel errors (400, 403, 404, 407, 502, 503, 504). This eliminates false "judge-side outage" misclassifications on dead proxies and preserves accurate rotating judge health. | Search Lead Noise & Asset Filtering:: Hardened `extractSearchLinks` in `WebScraper` to block search engine CDN assets (`yimg.com`, `yahooapis.com`, `brave.com`, `tiles.search.brave.com`, `cdn.search.brave.com`, `googleusercontent.com`, `bing.net`) and non-proxy media/data extensions (`.webmanifest`, `.ico`, `.webp`, `.png`, `.css`, `.jsonld`, `.xml`) across both primary and fallback search engine parsers. | Judge Pool Auto-Healing:: Added automatic state healing on initialization in `JudgeDiscovery` to clear erroneous legacy auto-quarantine flags on built-in judges caused by past proxy connection errors, restoring healthy endpoints without user intervention.
